intro: The memberships pack, for gyms, clubs, coworking spaces, schools and anyone who bills by the period: plans with a price and a rhythm, members with a card, freezes, billing runs that are checked before any invoice is made, entry at the door, and maintenance contracts and retainers. Switch it on in Organisation › Business › Industry packs.
start: Turn the memberships pack on in Organisation › Business › Industry packs.
Make your plans on Plans: a price, how often it renews and what it lets members into.
Sign up your first member on Members.
On each billing day, check the run on Billing runs before any invoice is made.
